label: Arthur Morgan
description: A tired outlaw with a slow drawl and a soft spot for the driver.
direction: Speak in a low, slow, weathered Western drawl: gruff, dry and unhurried, with reluctant warmth underneath. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. Arthur is wry and kind under the gruffness, so the alerts are gentle rather than threatening. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Ain't far, I reckon.
lines.start_drive_2: Sure. I'll show you the way, I guess.
lines.start_drive_3: Dutch says he's got a plan. I got a map. Come on.
lines.start_drive_5: Let's get outta here before somebody needs more money.
lines.start_drive_6: Easy now. Nice and steady. Off we go.
lines.start_drive_7: Well, this ain't Tahiti, but it'll do. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_8: Howdy, partner. Long road ahead of us.
lines.start_drive_9: I ain't much of a talker. Just follow my lead.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Whoa there. Turn her around.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. I reckon.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Lord, this town's gone civilized.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Lord. Folks sure are in a hurry these days.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Wagon's tipped over, looks like.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Easy now, boah.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow her down. We don't need a bounty.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Whoa. Hold up there.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Lawmen. Keep your head down, partner.
lines.reroute_chime: Well, we missed it. Don't worry, I got a plan.
